entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: Capital of Argive during the Brothers' War on the east coast of Terisiare, until the Fall of Penregon in 80 AR.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Blast that severely damaged Penregon with earthquakes and tidal waves.

entities.name: Lion's Hall
entities.description: Citadel on cliffs overlooking Penregon Harbor that collapsed into the sea.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Princess and wife of the alliance's leader who ruled Penregon after the blast.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Helped Kayla rebuild with civil automatons; later destroyed Urza's archives.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church angered by use of machines, which launched the Siege of Penregon.

entities.name: Siege of Penregon
entities.description: Church of Tal assault beaten back by civil automatons in spring of 69 AR.

entities.name: Fall of Penregon
entities.description: Flight of inhabitants west in 80 AR to avoid the cold.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Nation including Penregon's site after the Thaw.

entities.name: Argivia
entities.description: Original city destroyed in the Phyrexian Invasion; new city built on former Penregon.

events.summary: Penregon survives the Sylex Blast severely damaged; earthquakes and tidal waves level it and the king and court fall into the sea.
Kayla bin-Kroog inherits rule and rebuilds with Tawnos and civil automatons.
events.quote: the rule of the city fell to her

events.summary: The Church of Tal launches the Siege of Penregon and is beaten back by the civil automatons.
events.quote: which launched the Siege of Penregon but were beaten back

events.summary: Tawnos destroys Urza's archives and leaves, ending the age of artifice.
events.quote: the repentant Tawnos destroyed Urza's archives and left the city

events.summary: The inhabitants flee west to escape the cold in the Fall of Penregon.
events.quote: the inhabitants were forced to flee to the west to avoid the encroaching cold

relations.quote: Penregon was the capital of Argive
the rule of the city fell to her
Kayla tried to rebuild the city with the help of Tawnos
which launched the Siege of Penregon
